cash_registers_closed_fields_present.name: cash_registers_closed_fields_present
cash_registers_closed_fields_present.value: "cash_registers"."status" <> 'closed' or ("cash_registers"."closed_by" is not null and "cash_registers"."closed_at" is not null and "cash_registers"."closing_amount" is not null and "cash_registers"."expected_cash" is not null and "cash_registers"."cash_total" is not null and "cash_registers"."transfer_total" is not null and "cash_registers"."total_sales" is not null and "cash_registers"."difference" is not null)

payments_received_amount_valid.name: payments_received_amount_valid
payments_received_amount_valid.value: ("payments"."payment_method" = 'cash' and ("payments"."received_amount" is null or "payments"."received_amount" >= "payments"."amount")) or ("payments"."payment_method" <> 'cash' and "payments"."received_amount" is null)

restaurant_orders_business_date_number_u.name: restaurant_orders_business_date_number_unique
restaurant_orders_business_date_number_u.where: "restaurant_orders"."business_date" is not null and "restaurant_orders"."number" is not null

restaurant_orders_confirmed_fields_prese.name: restaurant_orders_confirmed_fields_present
restaurant_orders_confirmed_fields_prese.value: "restaurant_orders"."status" = 'draft' or ("restaurant_orders"."number" is not null and "restaurant_orders"."business_date" is not null and "restaurant_orders"."confirmed_at" is not null and "restaurant_orders"."cash_register_id" is not null)

restaurant_orders_ready_after_confirmed.name: restaurant_orders_ready_after_confirmed
restaurant_orders_ready_after_confirmed.value: "restaurant_orders"."ready_at" is null or "restaurant_orders"."confirmed_at" is not null

restaurant_orders_delivered_after_ready.name: restaurant_orders_delivered_after_ready
restaurant_orders_delivered_after_ready.value: "restaurant_orders"."delivered_at" is null or "restaurant_orders"."ready_at" is not null

restaurant_orders_cancelled_fields_prese.name: restaurant_orders_cancelled_fields_present
restaurant_orders_cancelled_fields_prese.value: "restaurant_orders"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("restaurant_orders"."cancelled_at" is not null and "restaurant_orders"."cancelled_by" is not null and length(trim("restaurant_orders"."cancel_reason")) > 0)
